card.name: The digit 9 in references and dates
card.fires_on: The single digit 9 when it stands alone as a number inside a citation, section number, verse number, or calendar date. It appears after a dot, colon, month name, or comma.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The digit 9 as the last part of a numbered section cited in parentheses.

modes.label: Dates
modes.description: The digit 9 as a day of the month after a month name.

modes.label: Verse numbers
modes.description: The digit 9 as a verse number after a chapter and colon.

card.plain: It lights up on the number 9 when it is a day, a verse, or a section number in a reference.
